Moving all text conversations to be encrypted to ensure user privacy

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Elon Musk megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: XChat (@chat); megjelent: 2026-11-18T19:22:47+00:00; link: https://x.com/chat/status/2123134844540448943; média: nincs média]
To continue optimizing the X experience, support for legacy groups on XChat will be ending this Friday.

All unencrypted conversations will become encrypted, and group members not on XChat by Friday will need to sign up for XChat to be reincluded in those conversations.
